programme.title: Donalda Trampa atgriešanās
programme.desc: Trampam gūstot uzvaru vēlēšanās, pieaug bailes to cilvēku vidū, kurus viņš uzskatīs par nodevējiem. ASV nav bijis tāda prezidenta kā Donalds Tramps, un tagad viņš atgriezies Baltajā namā. Šoreiz viņam ir detalizēts plāns, kā vajāt tos, kuri bija pret viņu netaisni pirmajā reizē. Gandrīz četrus gadus pēc tam, kad vēlētāji viņu padzina un viņš tika apsūdzēts par amerikāņu sakūdīšanu uzbrukt savai demokrātijai un ASV Kapitolijam, Tramps grib pārveidot valsti pēc sava priekšstata. Lai to paveiktu, viņam vajadzēs tikt galā ar tiem, kas iepriekš viņam traucēja. Tramps vēlas mainīt Amerikas demokrātijas balstus un sev piešķirt vairāk varas. Mēs izpētīsim "Projektu 2025" - Trampa plānu otrajam prezidenta pilnvaru laikam - un aplūkosim lišķīgu rekrūšu armiju, kas gatava pildīt viņa pavēles un iznīcināt noliedzējus.

programme.title: Vieglatlētika. Eiropas čempionāts
programme.desc: Pasaules čempionāts Birmingemā beigsies ar pēdējiem septiņiem fināliem, svētdien vairs nebūs nekādu priekšsacīkšu vai kvalifikācijas. Latvijas uzmanība varētu būt pievērsta šķēpa mešanai sievietēm, kur finālā vajadzētu startēt Anetei Sietiņai. Fināls sāksies vēlu, pulksten 21.55 pēc Latvijas laika. Sievietēm būs arī 1500 metru distance, tāllēkšana un 4x400 metru stafete. Vīriešiem programmā būs trīs veidi, bez 4x400 metru stafetes – arī 3000 metru kavēkļu skrējiens un kārtslēkšana, kur galvenais favorīts ir zviedrs Armands Duplantiss. Viņš gan nesen jūlijā nepabeidza Londonas posmu, un grūti vērtēt viņa formu, sliktākajā gadījumā Duplantiss var arī izlaist Eiropas čempionātu. Ja viņš piedalās, visi gaida uzvaru un kārtējo pasaules rekordu. Pēdējā sacensību diena Birmingemā beigsies tikai ap pusnakti pēc Latvijas laika.

programme.desc: "Province" – tie ir valsts bēniņi. Tā ir kā savdabīga pasaule, kam ikdienā mēs, viesistabu un guļamistabu apdzīvotāji, nepievēršam daudz uzmanības. Laiks šeit rit pēc citiem likumiem. Tas atnāk gandrīz tikpat ātri, bet aiziet lēnāk un ilgāk kavējas. Katrai valstij un tautai ir vajadzīgi savi bēniņi. Tie dod kādu īpašu stabilitāti, kas nekā citādi nav iegūstama. Bēniņu lielākā bagātība ir to spēja būt citādiem…

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: Ilze Vainovska ir no pilsētas vētru un dzintara krastā. Viņa ir no tiem liepājniekiem, kuri lielo pūtienu tieši īpaši gaida, jo tad nāk dzintars Sākumā viņa bijusi tikai rušinātāja, kas pārmeklē citu izsmelto, bet pēc pirmā pašas noķertā dzintara tikusi pie augstā novērtējuma – savas ķeseles un dzintara ķērājas vārda. Ilzei patīk neapstrādāts dzintars ar savu unikālo dabas formu, un tāds tas tiek iemezglots dažādās rotās. Vēl viņa darbojas onkoloģijas pacientu atbalsta biedrībā "Dzīvības koks", ir aizrāvusies ar Gruziju un pa drusciņai pieskata gan savu vietu, gan pilsētu un arī valsti Bet par sevi jokojot saka, ka ir bišķiņ ar galvu pasista nelabojama optimiste.

Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Mākslas dialogs
programme.desc: Raidījuma centrā – dekoratore, vides dizainere un skaistu lietu pazinēja Baiba Prindule-Rence, kas katrā epizodē kopā savedīs divus māksliniekus no vienas vai tuvu stāvošas jomas, piemēram, keramikas, stikla, pinumiem, rotām, tērpiem u. tml. Vienu, kas darbojas ar latviešu tradicionālajā daiļamatniecībā un kultūrā sakņotu pieeju un zināšanām, un otru, kas pārstāv moderno mūsdienu redzējumu. Kopīgi trijatā viņi izzinās cits cita pasaules – darbnīcas, darbošanās tehniku, darbus un pieeju radošajam procesam, bet pēcāk radošas prāta vētras rezultātā nonāks pie idejas kopdarbam ar divām šķautnēm, diviem mākslinieciskiem redzējumiem, kas saplūduši vienā. Vai tas maz būs iespējams? Vai tas būs viegli vai grūti? Vai pašiem patiks rezultāts? To visu jautāsim epizodes noslēgumā – darbu izstādē, kas būs redzama ne tikai TV ekrānā, bet arī apmeklējama dzīvē.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Pasaules maratonists apmeklē Kanāriju salas un tiekas ar dažādiem skrējējiem. Ar kādu sievieti, kurai skriešana saistās ar ģimenes atbalstu, jo skriešanā iesaistīta visa ģimene. Citā salā viņš satiek skrējēju, kura ar skriešanu atbalsta bērnus. Rauls arī uzzina, ka senāk cilvēki sazinājās svilpojot, un piedalās grūtā 17 kilometru skrējienā.

programme.title: Hadsons un Reksis
programme.desc: Džesija un Stellas uzstāšanās izvēršas nepatīkamā notikumā, kad viņi krodziņā kļūst par saindēšanās upuriem un arī galvenajiem lieciniekiem. Detektīvi strādā, lai atrastu indētāju starp kroga apmeklētājiem. Džesijs atskārš, ka cilvēki varēja saindēties Ņūfaundlendas tradicionālajā iesvētību ceremonijā, bučojot saldētu mencu. Viņš arī apjauš, ka viens cilvēks, kas piedalījās iesvētībās, ir pazudis. Turklāt nav zināms, vai šī persona saindēja pārējos vai ir kārtējais upuris, kam vajag pretindi. Detektīviem jāpasteidzas, lai apturētu indētāju, pirms viņš apklusina savu izvēlēto upuri.

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: CEV Eiropas Volejbola līga. Rumānija – Latvija
programme.desc: Komandu sporta spēļu hallē Rīgā nedēļas nogalē būs daudz volejbola, jo te sabraukuma spēles Eiropas līgā aizvadīs gan sieviešu, gan vīriešu komandas. Sieviešu volejbola izlases galvenais treneris Daniele Mario Kaprioti izveidojis labu komandu, un izlase pēc ļoti daudzu gadu pārtraukuma kvalificējusies Eiropas čempionāta finālturnīram. Pēdējo reizi tas bija izdevies ļoti sen, 1997. gadā. Latvijas valstsvienība gatavošanos sāka jau maija sākumā, kaut vēl ne pilnā sastāvā. Sākumā kandidātu pulkā bija 16 spēlētājas, bet beigās jau ap 25-26. Pašās galvenajās sacensībās Eiropas čempionātā gan varēs startēt tikai labākās 14. Izlases līdere ir Marta Kamēlija Levinska, kas ikdienā spēlē Vācijā, Drēzdenes klubā, taču arī vairākas citas mūsu volejbolistes sezonu aizvadījušas gana augstā līmenī citu valstu komandās. Sieviešu izlase jau aizvadījusi treniņspēli ar Lietuvu, tāpat pārbaudes spēles pret Igauniju un Somiju. Eiropas līgas pirmajā sabraukumā mūsu pretinieces ir Rumānijas un Izraēlas izlases.

programme.title: Aizraujošie vilcienu maršruti
programme.desc: Šis Lielbritānijā veidotais televīzijas raidījumu cikls veltīts dzelzceļu tīklam visā Eiropā un pat ārpus tās robežām, kā arī ceļvedim, kura mērķis pirms vairāk nekā simts gadiem bija sniegt britu ceļotājiem gan svarīgu, gan izklaidējošu informāciju par galamērķiem dažādās valstīs. Raidījuma vadītājs ir Maikls Portillo, britu žurnālists, TV un radio raidījumu vadītājs, kurš darbojies arī politikā. Tā kā raidījumos izmantotais "Bredšova kontinentālā dzelzceļa ceļvedis" izdots 1913. gadā, katrā no sērijām uzzināsim gan kaut ko par situāciju vadītāja apmeklētajā valstī pirms Pirmā pasaules kara, gan arī to, kā pilsētas un valstis mainījušās gadsimta gaitā.

programme.title: Zīdītāji
programme.desc: Vairāk nekā divas trešdaļas zīdītāju kļūst aktīvi pēc saulrieta. Kamēr cilvēki guļ ciešā miegā, lielākā daļa zīdītāju visā pasaulē nakti pavada rosīgi. Tas iegājies jau kopš seniem laikiem, kad zīdītāji dienā slēpās no dinozauriem, bet naktī devās baroties. Šajā sērijā uzzināsim, kādas spējas ļauj zīdītājiem naktīs veiksmīgi medīt, satikt savu mīlestību, izdzīvot un baroties. Leopards nakts tumsā medī viens, bet hiēnām vajadzīgi papildspēki; ja vien tuksnesī būtu adata, tad feneks dzirdētu to nokrītam, bet dzirdi viņš izmanto praktiskākiem mērķiem; mazākais zīdītājs uz planētas cirslis uztur savu nepārtrauktā kustībā esošo enerģisko dzīvesveidu, savukārt bruņnesim ar lielisku ožu nepietiek, lai iekarotu sirdsdāmu. Vienīgais zīdītājs, kurš spēj lidot, ir iekarojis lielāko daļu pasaules dzīvotņu – pat pilsētas, kur sagādā cilvēkiem izrādes!

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Eimija mirst sava priekšnesuma laikā. Atklājas, ka viņa ir noindēta ar strihnīnu. Tā pēdas atrod kakla skalošanas pudelē, ko aiztikusi viņas sāncense Eloīza. Taču Eloīza noliedz vainu. Beidzot Ričardam izdodas atrisināt mīklu, kāpēc skalošanas pudele bijusi tikai pēdu jaukšanai.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Apceļojot vēl citas Kanāriju salas, mūsu maratonists izveido savu "sapņu komandu", lai piedalītos kādā īpašā komandu skrējienā. Katrs dalībnieks ar savu dzīvesstāstu pārstāv kādu īpašību – motivāciju, ticību. Visi kopā viņi cenšas nepievilt cits citu 12 kilometrus garajā nakts skrējienā. Jāfinišē visiem kopā.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: Broukenvuda
programme.desc: Broukenvuda ir parasts nomaļš ciemats – tādā var iemaldīties, braucot no jebkuras lielpilsētas. Cilvēki te ir jauki, komunikabli un savā starpā pazīstami. Ciematā ir golfa klubs un vīna degustēšanas pasākumi. Viss, kas ciematam piederas… arī seni noslēpumi, meli un slepkavības. Inspektors Maiks Šeperds un viņa partnere Kristīna Simsa ir atbildīgi par mieru pilsētā. Viņi izmeklē mistiskās, atjautīgās un nežēlīgās slepkavības. Seriāls ieguvis "TV Drāmas bronzas godalgu" Ņujorkas starptautiskajā filmu un televīzijas festivālā.

programme.title: Midsomeras slepkavības
programme.desc: Detektīvs Toms Bārnabijs ir pacietīgs un metodisks izmeklētājs. Viņš saprot, ka noziegumiem mazā pilsētiņā vienmēr būs sociāls raksturs, tamdēļ svarīgi izprast tās iedzīvotāju attiecības. Tikai un vienīgi viņš spēj pamanīt neskaidrus mājienus un sadzīt pēdas viltīgam slepkavam brīdī, kad nupat, šķiet, tas izbēgs nesodīts. Kad Toms Bārnabijs atgriežas mājās, viņš ir mīlošs vīrs un tēvs, tomēr, neskatoties uz to, detektīvs viņā nekad nesnauž. Citreiz vistrāpīgākās atklāsmes rodas tieši pie brokastu galda! Seriāls "Midsomeras slepkavības" ieturēts vislabākajās britu klasiskā detektīva tradīcijās: virkne aizdomās turamo, sajauktas pēdas, mīklaini mājieni, neizprotami motīvi un iespēja skatītājam pašam minēt, kurš šoreiz būs vainīgais. Seriāls veiksmīgi izrādīts teju visās Eiropas valstīs, kā arī ASV, Kanādā, Dienvidāfrikā un Tuvajos Austrumos, kopumā tas tiek uzņemts jau vairāk nekā 25 gadus.

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Mikrofona dziesmas
programme.desc: Jau sen aiz kalniem tas laiks, kad gada nogalē Latvijas Radio klausītāji ar nepacietību gaidīja "Mikrofona" dziesmu aptaujas rezultātus. Žurnālists Gunārs Jākobsons bija tas, kurš jau 1967. gadā lūkoja sarīkot speciālu latviešu dziesmu aptauju, sākumā bez klausītāju atsaucības, tomēr 1968. gadā aptauja izdevās, un tajā uzvarēja Raimonda Paula un Alfrēda Krūkļa dziesma "Mežrozīte", tobrīd atslēdznieka Zigfrīda Račiņa priekšnesumā. "Mikrofona" dziesmu aptauja ar dažiem pārtraukumiem notika līdz pat 1993. gadam.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A380 Turnaround Coordinator, Diana orchestrates Cargo, Ground Operations and Baggage Services to get the biggest passenger plane off the ground. Night works on a new taxiway mark the beginning of an airport wide upgrade and an I.T. outage stops international passengers at the border as the Integrated Operations Centre swing into action to resolve congestion.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Baggage manager Brodie races against the clock to reunite a passenger with their lost luggage. An airport visitor faces an unexpected mishap. In the hangar, engineers tackle a complex engineering challenge. As a full moon rises, the night shift contends with problem passengers. Adding to the pressure, a construction crew's staircase installation risks blocking the airport's sole access road.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A Bali-bound flight faces delays after a service truck crashes into its undercarriage. Australian Border Force find illegal weapons in a passenger's luggage. Unregistered taxi drivers are caught in the act and there's a fuel leak on the tarmac. At night, a mysterious Soviet-era plane lands unannounced.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP discovers four kilograms of cocaine concealed within two cakes, and then HSI follows the case from Miami to Atlanta to dismantle an interstate smuggling ring. CBP Miami inspects a load of in-transit mail and uncovers two suspicious packages - a drum and machine part - that may contain narcotics. CBP New York cracks-down on the importation of illicit money, and investigates multiple travelers attempting to bring-in large sums of undeclared cash.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will travels deep into the Kalahari Desert to meet the San people, one of the oldest hunter-gatherer groups on Earth. To discover the secret to their enduring success, he must join them on a hunt in one of the most inhospitable places on the planet. Led by local San bushman guide Kane Motswana, it's not long before he realizes he's entirely unsuited to this adventure.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Joined by linguist Dr. Mary Walworth and local marine ecologist John Aini, Will travels to the South Pacific on an expedition to a remote island threatened by rising seas. What begins as an exploration into an incredible marine paradise quickly transforms into a truly revelatory journey for Will about his own history as they record a lost language spoken by only five people.

programme.title: Break It Down
programme.desc: While the ingenuity, skill, logistics and sheer hard work that are required to construct massive structures and state-of-the-art machines is well-documented, what is less well-known is that the same amount of effort is often required to deconstruct these creations. This docu-series follows the crews of engineers and deconstruction specialists as they breakdown these buidings and machines so that they can be recycled. Among the many stories on offer are those of a demolition team working against the clock to bring down an unstable and unsafe bridge; the difficulties faced in breaking up a building that was intended to be impenetrable: a prison; the potential recycling opportunities in a yard full of scrap locomotives; and what to do with the valuable wreckages of Porsche cars.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: Catastrophic events often require life-saving machines, and to function reliably, they have a certain technological mystery. Emergency teams risk their lives when fighting earthquakes, forest fires and extreme nature events. With climate change affecting the globe and extreme situations occurring more often, advanced technology is a priority when designing machines that need to save lives.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: A huge part of our economy is reliant upon freight transport. Industries from all over the world depend on freight aircraft, offshore vessels and electric trains to increase overall productivity. Experts investigate how these colossal transporters are designed to carry massive amounts of goods quickly and efficiently.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: A container ship strikes the Francis Scott Key Bridge, causing it to collapse and paralyze the Port of Baltimore. Other fails include a roof collapse at a Dutch soccer stadium, a crane fire 45 floors over Manhattan, two Scottish towers that fail to fall in a controlled demolition, and a sewer pressure test in China that sends a "poonami" into the sky. It's enough to turn one to drink … at the Crooked House, England's wonkiest pub.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: In Turkey, buildings claiming to be earthquake-proof end up falling down. Two gantry cranes bump into each other on a harbor in Taiwan; and a battery factory blows up in South Korea, resulting in a bad day at the office. Knob and tube wiring might be obsolete, but the Sydney Opera House is going strong, despite its many initial design flaws. The city of Dresden wishes they could reverse engineer the collapse of the Carola Bridge.

programme.title: Atlas of Cursed Places
programme.desc: Everybody has heard about Dracula, a blood-thirsty monster who invokes immortality with a bite on the neck. But many believe the real Dracula was a 15th century eastern European ruler with a penchant for impaling enemies, Vlad Tepes, whose curse upon his homeland has lasted for six centuries. With the help of emerging science in the field of genetics, Sam investigates the curse of Vlad the Impaler.

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: Since 1993 UFO sightings have haunted some residents of Phoenix, Arizona. Reports from hundreds of people all note seeing a triangular formation of lights in the sky. Ryder, Ben, and James start by watching the video footage first captured in 1993 that also highlights a similar shaped item floating above. The man who caught the sighting on video, Terry Connet, comes forward to explain just how enormous and eerily silent the object was. After the original Phoenix Lights incident, the military stated that it was simply dropped flairs from a nearby Air Force Base, others believe it was skydivers.

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: Before NASA's shuttle program shut down, residents in Florida reported a series of strange glowing orbs trailing the shuttle's launch into space. Ryder, Ben, and James launch a daring mission around Kennedy Space Center to investigate if aliens are watching earth from above. The team's determination to conclude if aliens are spying on our world involves braving swamps infested with reptiles and even evading an oncoming boat.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Across the planet thousands of crop circles have been reported. Most of these patterns are dismissed as hoaxes, but for some they beg the question, are these crop circles manmade, or something Paranatural? Is there any chance crop circles are messages from another world? Or are they just a series of pranks?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Paranatural investigates the disappearances of ships and planes in the area known as the Bermuda Triangle. Some believe theres something amiss in this patch of sea, but tales of the Triangle are the stuff of legend, roundly dismissed by skeptics as tragic, but explainable disappearances. Most scientists arent interested in the Bermuda Triangle, but there is a different mysterious area hovering just above the Earth that has gotten their attention.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: In this special episode of Ice Road Rescue, Thord rescues an Estonian Trucker who isn't prepared for bad weather and doesn't listen very well. Bjoern must deal with an inexperienced driver on Death Hill trying to get 27 tons of truck and garbage up the slippery incline and Ole Henrik is trying to help a wayward Romanian trucker who is stuck without chains on an uphill corner on a main thoroughfare in a small town.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Coastal erosion exposes skeletal remains, revealing the haunting past of Medieval floating prisons. A special type of spider is discovered on an isolated island. Archaeologists uncover evidence that could point to the fate of the lost Roanoke settlers. Thousands of dead seals are found with strange corkscrew wounds in Canada, confounding experts.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Explore some of history's most extreme medical practices. Aboard the wreck of the infamous pirate ship Queen Anne's Revenge, archaeologists uncover surgical tools once used to treat injured sailors — but they reveal a brutal reality of pain, infection and limited care on the high seas. In Peru, excavations at the fortress of Kuélap expose human remains bearing signs of trepanation, an ancient form of skull surgery that required remarkable anatomical knowledge and steady hands. Meanwhile, on the American frontier, evidence recovered from Lewis and Clark's expedition latrines reveals the use of "thunderbolts," a powerful mercury-based medicine carried to treat illnesses during their journey. Across oceans, mountains and continents, these discoveries reveal the desperate and daring measures people once took to survive.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: From the bizarre to the brilliant, ancient medicine reveals humanity's boldest attempts to heal. European medical texts once praised powdered mummy as a cure all, spurring demand for human remains taken from Egyptian tombs. In Austria, villagers consumed arsenic, believing controlled doses improved their complexion, breathing and vitality — despite its lethal nature. Far across the world, in ancient Mayan lands, a sweat bath carved with a powerful deity offers insight into rituals surrounding pregnancy and birth. Through archaeology and expert insight, the episode reveals how different cultures embraced unconventional treatments, each shaped by fear, tradition, and a desire to understand the body.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: After Chinggis Khan's secret burial, his son Ogedei is proclaimed ruler of the Mongol Empire. He brings a very different leadership style as he conquers Armenia, Georgia and the Jin Empire. He orders the building of the grand capital of Karakorum and sets the stage for a brutal campaign against Kievan Rus, led by his nephew Batu and the veteran general Subudai.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: The Mongolian Empire launched a devastating campaign through the lands of Russia and Europe, crushing knights with Mongol speed and strategy. As they prepared to push deeper into Europe, news of Ogedei's death halted the advance, triggering a struggle for succession over an empire that now stretched from China to Europe, the largest the world had ever seen.

programme.title: Naming the Dead
programme.desc: Across the United States, more than 50,000 bodies remain unidentified—unmourned, unnamed, but not forgotten. "Naming The Dead", a riveting new six-part investigative series from National Geographic, brings these untold stories to light. The series follows the groundbreaking work of the DNA Doe Project, a trailblazing nonprofit that uses genetic genealogy to help law enforcement crack the country's most confounding cold cases.

programme.title: Atlas of Cursed Places
programme.desc: Everybody has heard about Dracula, a blood-thirsty monster who invokes immortality with a bite on the neck. But many believe the real Dracula was a 15th century eastern European ruler with a penchant for impaling enemies, Vlad Tepes, whose curse upon his homeland has lasted for six centuries. With the help of emerging science in the field of genetics, Sam investigates the curse of Vlad the Impaler.

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: In an area known as the "Roswell of South America", or Varginha Brazil, the Chasing UFOs team investigates a series of UFO sightings and rumors of alien life forms hiding in the jungles, including a reported alien sighting from 1996. Their hunt for answers leads the team through some of the wildest terrain on Earth, where they brave the rapids of South Americas waterways, explore a poorly ventilated cave in the depths of the jungle and literally walk into a giant spiders nest. But the most compelling evidence they find comes from a series of eyewitness in the city, including the former commander of the Brazilian airspace defence command who offers some inspiring insight into the UFO activity. The evidence may be strong enough to transform Ryder into a full on believer. She says, "For the first time in my life Im caught believing that the possibility of UFOs is all too real."

programme.title: Chasing UFOs
programme.desc: Baby alien or a tiny species of monkey? In Mexico, Ryder, Ben and James meet a leading UFOlogist to get a first-hand look at a tiny creature of mysterious origin. Firm believer James has no doubt the creature is alien but skeptic Ben offers a more down to earth explanation. While in Mexico, they also investigate the "Mother Ship Videos" incredible footage that some believe shows a mother ship dropping off hundreds of UFOs in the sky. James is further compelled by the fact that two eyewitnesses recorded the same event from two different angles.

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: Scotland's Livingston UFO, Norway's Hessdalen Lights and Portugal's Castelo de Bode Dam encounter. On 17th June, 1977 a young Portuguese pilot comes face to face with a large unknown object at 5,000 feet. He observes it for a few seconds before it vanishes into the clouds. Suddenly, his magnetic compass spins wildly and his aircraft goes into an uncontrolled nose dive. In the early 1980's hundreds of mysterious lights are witnessed flying through the Hessdalen Valley in Norway. Scientist Erling Strand from Ostfold University College is keen to investigate so he sets up camp in the valley. He is amazed at the spectacular lights and after capturing them on film, discovers something intriguing. In 1979 a Scottish forester describes an incredible encounter with a UFO in a lonely clearing. He falls down unconscious and when he comes to, finds cuts on his legs and tears on his trousers. The police launch the UK's first ever criminal investigation into a UFO encounter.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Duty Manager Dan must deal with a check-in outage at the start of the busy school holidays. Airside Safety responds to a life-or-death medical emergency on an incoming flight. 68 racehorses valued at $300 million dollars arrive from Europe. Overnight, the airside lighting team carry out vital work while dodging planes.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: This breath-taking aerial trip explores the Balkan Peninsula from new heights. Gliding over the mountainous terrain, our aerial cameras reveal an ancient gathering of giant monsters and a jaw-dropping winter migration. We'll uncover the region's other-worldly architectural gems, the blissful autumn hues of Croatia's magical Plitvice Lakes, and the iconic white horses of Lipica as they navigate Koper's Venetian streets for a festive carriage ride.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Atlantis, the legendary island believed to have sunk beneath the waves thousands of years ago, has puzzled the academic community for generations. Though many sites have been put forward, the Atlantis described by the philosopher Plato remains a mystery. The Truth Behind Atlantis aims to dive into the murky depths of the controversies that surround the island, sifting through historical accounts, scientific experiments and academic opinion. It's a journey that takes us to the tropical Bahamas, Miami, Santorini and to an archaeological site on Crete, as we untangle the past to discover the real story of Atlantis.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Crystal Skulls - mysterious artefacts found around the world that have captured the imagination of new age enthusiasts and esteemed academics alike. One skull in particular has long been the source of controversy and intrigue. The Truth Behind Crystal Skulls looks specifically at the provenance of the Mitchell-Hedges Crystal Skull, claimed to have been discovered in Belize in the early 20th Century. The program answers the questions that continue to mystify its proponents. Is it a contemporary object of art? Is it an ancient Mayan artefact dating to over 3000 years ago? This adventurous documentary finds the answers by delving in to the murky past of the skull and taking us on a journey through the streets of Beijing, the jungle of Belize and the cities of Washington DC and London UK to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: UFO's. Everyone's heard about them - but what are they exactly? The Truth Behind travels to the unofficial UFO capital of the world to investigate. Charting the rise of UFO sightings from the 1940's to the present day, the investigation examines the conspiracy theories, conducts a stakeout in the desert, looks into a recent sighting, and takes a field trip to a crash site in Nevada might unearth some clues. We'll hear the experiences of a man who's flown in a real flying saucer and has got the footage to prove it. All to find the Truth Behind UFOs.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Age of Dinosaurs - an ancient world of savage, lone T-rexes terrorizing dopey plant-eating diplodocus. So familiar… but so wrong. From the colours of their skin to the way they flock and herd, so much of what we think is true about dinosaurs is either out of date, guesswork, or all-out fantasy. Now a new generation of palaeontologists, armed with the latest tech, are challenging these popular caricatures to uncover the Real Jurassic Americas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Archaeologists explore the coast of Oregon for the remains of a ship that sank over three hundred years ago. Native American oral histories tell of a shipwreck and its survivors. Porcelain and beeswax from the ship still wash up on shore. Archaeologists reconstruct their impression of the sunken wreck, using historical data and their own expertise, revealing how this giant ship carried hundreds of tons of cargo nearly halfway round the world.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legends of Hercules. Excavators at Olympia uncover a colossal wall that may shed light on the hero's 12 labors. At Gibraltar, investigators explore a mysterious cavern beneath one of the so-called Pillars of Hercules.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: In 1981, the Federal Aviation Administration established the sterile cockpit rule requiring pilots to refrain from non-essential activities during critical phases of flight. When this rule is broken, the resulting distraction can be deadly. Passengers fight for their lives inside a burning plane at Dallas Fort Worth Airport. A brand new L-1011 crashes in a remote swamp in the Florida Everglades. And, during a demonstration flight, a brand new Russian Superjet slams into a mountain south of Jakarta.

programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Greatest Treasures of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Professor Bettany Hughes returns to explore the extraordinary and captivating mummies of Ancient Egypt. Egypt has a history like no other: nestling between the desert and the Nile, its extraordinary pyramids, soaring temples, and hidden tombs astonish and captivate. But nothing brings Egypt's past back to life like the mummies that survive it. Wrapped, embalmed, and buried with treasure for thousands of years, each mummy tells the story of the people - the criminals, priests, children and pharaohs - who lived the history we've come to know. Watch as Bettany takes the viewer through an extraordinary countdown of the faces behind the history, as she reveals stories of glimmering treasure, journeys into the afterlife, and cruel revenge - some of which are only coming to light after thousands of years.

programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the legacy of one of history's most famous figures: Alexander the Great. New discoveries reveal the architectural wonders of Pella in Greece and Ephesus in Turkey; and in Egypt, archaeologists also uncover a skeleton with terrible injuries. Could it hint at the dark side of this golden age?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: As gateways to eternal life, Egypt's tombs were built to last forever. But thousands of years later, time is winning. In a race to save hidden treasures, archaeological teams excavate the pyramids and burial sites on the verge of collapse. In Abusir, Dr. Mohamed Ishmail Khaled hunts for a long-lost royal chamber, before shifting stones seal it forever. In Philadelphia, Dr. Basem Gehad descends a shaft held up by crumbling sand walls in search of an unexplored tomb. Near Luxor, crews haul debris from a steep, unstable corridor leading to a newly discovered chamber. Every move is a risk to both the archaeologists and the fragile relics they're racing to protect.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have travelled to Milton Keynes to try and rescue Craig's 1930 Ford Model A, an historic car with an impressive pedigree. The car's owner is 58 year old former electrician Craig a dyed in the wool classic car lover. He's had his Model A for over 30 years, however after a tragic motor cycle accident any plans for restoration evaporated when his whole world was turned upside down. Once the car hits the Car SOS workshop its wooden coachwork and 90 year old parts prove a big challenge for the team.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Forfar in Scotland to rescue the rusting wreck of a rare Talbot Sunbeam Lotus. The car was the pride and joy of former firefighter, and lifelong rally enthusiast, Jim who had planned to restore it, however a back injury not only forced him to give up his job but also any plans to get his car back on the road. Once the boys get the car back in the workshop they discover they have something very special on their hands as the Talbot turns out to be an ultra-rare factory proto type.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Kent to try and salvage a 1991 VW T4 Campervan. The vehicle belongs to 42 year old carpenter Jon who bought his mobile home several year ago with the dream of taking his wife travelling around the world. Sadly before Jon's dream came true he was diagnosed with brain cancer, his whole world ground to a halt and his plans to restore and drive his beloved van had to go on hold. Will the Car SOS team be able to help resurrect Jon's dream?

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: On his first day, Australian Border Force recruit Nelson makes a find. A daring pushback trial ten years in the making involving multiple aircraft is under threat. Baggage manager Brodie faces the challenge of handling 2,000 bags during a system upgrade. A father and son pilot duo tackle a new flight simulator.

programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Wild South Africa
programme.desc: Wild South Africa is an amazing documentary series that aims to reveal all the unique beauty and wildness, unbelievable diversity and greatness of the country where you can find both heat and cold, desert and tropics. Have a look at the mighty oceans of the Cape Peninsula, where two ocean currents merge. See the the dry Kalahari Desert and its inhabitants. Check out fantastic animals of South African semi-deserts and savannahs, like caracals, servals, the insect-eating pangolin and many more.

programme.title: Wild South Africa
programme.desc: Sunshine, sandy beaches and palm trees - not only does the Caribbean boast them, so too does South Africa's East Coast. Here you are no longer privy to the rocky coastline of the Cape of Good Hope! It is hot and sticky all year round - the mangroves and the bayous in the east of the country present ideal conditions for strange frogs, mudskippers and enormous Nile crocodiles - still, occasionally it's also too hot to handle, even for them!

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The wild Pacific covers one third of our planet. It has the most volcanoes, the biggest earthquakes, deepest trenches, and the most islands on Earth. Found in icy sub-Antarctic waters, tropical coral seas, and still smoking volcanic arcs, there is no such thing as a typical Pacific island. The wildest and most bizarre creatures have evolved to thrive on these unique Islands of Life, often surviving nowhere else on Earth.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The ocean is full of wonders, but creating them has been a bloody battle for over half a billion years, as evermore complex animals fight for survival. They evolved new ways to hunt, overpower and kill and eat each other. And astonishing adaptations to defend themselves, hide and escape detection. Passing those amazing new abilities on to the next generation can be a bruising battle in itself as males fight each other for the right to mate.

programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold. Dirtbag's wild-at-heart instincts kick in, while Can Yang's extroverted and adaptable nature shines through. A new pair of ambassador pandas prepares for life overseas, while in the maternity unit, the nursery cubs are growing cuter by the day and learning to walk. And up the mountain, the first snows present a challenge for Tian Tian and the cub she's raising for the wild.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines, the giant rodents in Africa; the martial eagle, the biggest of its kind on the continent; and the leopard, a giant among the spotted cats.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style. The little twins are too young to start climbing, but they put their best paw forward when snow arrives. A snow day doesn't mean school is canceled; it means the lessons will be harder. While the littlest cubs are starting their schooling, Tian Tian's cub is up in the mountains and coming to the end of his lessons … inching closer to a life in the wild.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

programme.title: Caught in the Act
programme.desc: Caught in the Act is a television show presenting a collection of remarkable and unexpected animal behavior caught on film, from amazing maternal instincts, to dramatic fights, rescues and competition. A team of experts and the eyewitnesses who made the footage discuss these incredible wildlife moments that make us see the natural world in a different light. These tapes reveal the emotional side of animals, from tragic to hopeful. See how a baby hippo escapes from a shark, a warthhog takes on two lions and much more.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

programme.title: Tiger Queen of Taru
programme.desc: The story of Maya the tigress plays out in a tiger reserve in Tadoba, Central India. Here, Bengal tigers chase wild dogs, fight sloth bears and feud among themselves over bloodlines and territory in never-before seen footage. Maya writes her own rules when it comes to raising a litter, yet motherhood doesn't come easy. One thing is clear, Maya will do whatever it takes to secure her bloodline within the Kingdom of Taru.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: In the heart of India, a tiger family battles for dominance in the ruins of a lost empire. B1, a young tiger, challenges his aging grandfather for supremacy over their pride land, taking advantage of his slowed reflexes and struggling vision. Meanwhile, B1's mother tries to keep the peace for her new cubs during their risky first years of life, and for her father, who is becoming increasingly helpless. But B1 is bent on taking over and starting his own dynasty deep in the heart of ancient India.

programme.title: The World's Most Famous Tiger
programme.desc: Known as the Queen of Ranthambore, Machli is the most famous tiger in the world. The legendary tigress is a fearsome warrior known for her daring exploits. And she's the mother of an incredible four litters of cubs.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbazū gatavs palīdzēt, bet Barbagudrais un Barbabella ļaunprātīgi izmanto viņa labestību un padara viņu traku. Barbazū nejauši atklāj spēju atdarināt Barbatēti. Viņš to izmanto, lai sadalītu darbus brāļiem un māsām. Vai viņi to uzzinās?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni domā, ka ēdiens spēj likt tiem mainīt krāsu un formu, tāpēc izlemj atrast katram piemēroto ēdienu. Barbabo nav iedvesmas, tāpēc vairs nespēj radīt. Visa ģimene palīdz, iesakot jaunas zīmējumu tēmas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vecākus pārsteidz aizvien vairāku reklāmas izkārtņu parādīšanās gar viņu ceļu. Gaisma no reklāmām ir tik spoža, ka naktī vairs nevar saskatīt zvaigznes un visur ir tik daudz stabu! Pietiks! Ģimenei jārīkojas! // Barbalala vēlas kļūt par kovbojmeiteni un Barbazū ir apņēmies viņai palīdzēt. Lai to panāktu, viņai jāiemācās aprūpēt govis un bulli. Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Motorei vajag palīdzību ugunsdzēsēju depo, pilsētā ierodas jauns ugunsdzēsēju kapteinis, lai apmācītu visus ķepaiņus. Čārdžers grib palīdzēt Sjerrai Spīdošajai ar viņas jauno šovu, bet viņa savainotā ķepa izraisa konusveidīgus sarežģījumus.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīcī apmetas migrējošu pīļu bars. Rabla komandai jāpalīdz pīlēm uzsākt ceļu uz dienvidiem. Motore nevēlas doties pie dakteres Divas uz veterināro klīniku... tāpēc ķepaiņi uzbūvē īpašu, tikai viņai paredzētu telpu.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Tērauds grib doties uz Mēnesi un liek profesoram Skrambai pārvērst Tērauda torņus par kosmosa raķeti. Burvis nozog publikas uzmanību no Ramija uzstāšanās. Ramijs atriebjas, paņemot viņa cepuri un radot trušu invāziju.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars nozog Rabla komandas autobusu, ķepaiņiem tas jāatgūst, lai paspētu uz Sjerras Spīdošās koncertu. Celtnieklīcī ir lieliska diena pludmalei! Rabla komandai jābūvē glābēju tornis, lai pludmalē būtu aboslūti droši.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora rāda dvīņiem mūzikas lādīti, kuras mazā dejotāja atdzīvojas! Kad aizbēg viņas burvju zābaciņi, draugi dodas tos meklēt. Saule nevar iemigt, tāpēc atsakās norietēt! Dorai jāatrod Spilvenmākonis, lai Saule varētu doties pie miera.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kucēnu iemīļotajām grāmatām iznācis turpinājums! Tām nav vietas bibliotēkā, tāpēc kucēniem jābūt radošiem! Kucēni Rablam gatavo pārsteigumu - uzkodu mašīnu, bet vai Rabls neko nenojautīs?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Doras ģimene taisa pinjatu par godu māmiņas dzimšanas dienai, taču tā aizlido! Vai viņi to atradīs, pirms pārnāks māmiņa? Garnadzis nočiepj neredzamības segu un sāk čiept visu pēc kārtas. Dorai viņš jāaptur!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tija un Tomijs rīko talantu šovu, bet nevar izlemt, kurš uzstāsies pirmais.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

Viņiem jāpārdod savi darbiņi ikgadējā lielajā tirdziņā, ja tētis paspēs laicīgi... // Uzsniga sniegs un bērni sarīkoja pikošanos, bet Barbabo uzcēla lielisku sniegavīru. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Isu apciemos Rāpuļu karaliene, bet dārzā valda nekārtība! Dora palīdz Isai gatavoties Karalienes vizītei. Dora iepazīstas ar sliņķi Semiju, kuram jāpagūst laikus nokļūt dienas nometnē, lai visus pārsteigtu.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Vectēvs Grants māca Čārdžeram savus labākos deju soļus deju sacensībām. Vai noklīdušas disko umbass dēļ netiks gūta pirmā vieta?

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Kad Tedijs un Fredijs ierodas pie Deizijas spēlēties, viņi atrod viņas senu mīļāko rotaļlietu - mazu zoss figūriņu vārdā Zosīte. Redzot, cik ļoti tā patīk viņas brāļiem, viņa to viņiem uzdāvina, atzīstot, ka vairs ar to nespēlējas. Tiklīdz tā atdota, viņa sāk ilgoties pēc Zosītes, it īpaši pēc tam, kad uzzina, ka zēni nomainījuši tās vārdu uz Dino Džims. Krokodila kungs nolemj palīdzēt Deizijai atgūt savu rotaļlietu un atrast aizvietotāju, ar ko zēni varētu spēlēties, bet dvīņi vēlas Zosīti!

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un tētis netiek prom attāla asteroīda. Tims, Kaja un Tomijs cenšas dabūt laukā bumbu no mammas istabas. Tims cenšas dabūt lejā Tijas jauno balonu, kas ieķēries kokā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora un Zābaciņš pieskata krokodilu bērneļus. Dora un Zābaciņš pierunā Trolli nogaršot empanadu Benija kioskā. Zābaciņš uzlaiko Tiko izgudrotus zābakus. Dvīņi priecājas par savu pirmo pinjatu, bet neviens nezina, kā to dabūt vaļā.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.desc: New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, and bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent. As the danger increases, the Thunderman trio must stay in town indefinitely, leaving the squabbling twins in charge of raising their younger sister.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.
